**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The split keeps every assertion. The old rotary test called `parity` three times and `eye_cost` three times. The six new tests make the same six calls. The `parity` and `eye_cost` bodies did not change.
- The `#[test]` counts match the body. `crates/app/tests/rotary_field_parity.rs`: 4 (1 ignored) before, 9 (6 ignored) after. `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs`: 1 test before; 15 at run time after (the `per_file!` macro makes 14, plus the file-set test).
- Each new ignored test carries a reason that names its lane: `heavy lane (M13.1 rotary parity)`. The law in AGENTS.md ("Laws and verdicts run in different lanes") holds.
- The kernel suite keeps its lane. No new test is `#[ignore]`d, so `camcraft-kernel` runs the 15 tests in the same lane it ran the one test before. Nothing moved to a lane where it never executes.
- The file-set test keeps both old guards. It checks the files on disk against `ROWS`, in order, and it checks that every row has its own test. A file with no row still fails the bench.
- `check_row` in `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs:380` uses `assert!` and a `let-else`, not `unwrap`. No new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside test code.
- No stale reference to the removed test name `every_rotary_kind_reads_the_radial_law_and_its_cost_is_measured` remains in the tree. The gate maps cover modules, not test names, so they need no update.
- The body is complete: what changed, how it was tested, what was not run, `Changelog: none` (a test-only PR needs no row), and `Refs #1715` for partial work. The subject is conventional.

## Results

Built on the self-hosted runner (macOS), not in a local worktree: run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43651693458 , merged with `main` at `0db66c44e244a608a860ffea8459762a74cfe838`.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with main | clean |
| Quick gate — kernel suites | ok, 87 s (the new 15-test `step_agreement` runs in parallel) |
| Quick gate — app suites | ok, 30 s |
| Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The diff adds no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned reading, so no local Windows re-run is owed.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/tests/rotary_field_parity.rs` is now 408 lines and `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs` is 437. Both passed the ~400-line guide with this PR. A later split of the remaining fixtures can bring them back under it.
- The body names the work that stays for #1715: `the_sample_as_imported_still_generates_the_3d_finish` in `crates/app/tests/shared_face_bodies.rs`, and the per-test time in the gate summary. That matches the `Refs` keyword.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
